ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible left fluke lobe; right lobe is predominantly low-intensity pixels where visible.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) contiguous blob occupying the distal-lateral portion of the left lobe; a solid low-intensity (black) central corridor; four distinct parallel high-contrast curvilinear bands located in the proximal-medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel amplitude) with an irregular notched cluster approximately 15% inward from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe leading edge follows a continuous parabolic convex curve; trailing edge is approximately linear with a localized proximal concavity transitioning into the obscured median area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scatter of localized high-intensity pixel clusters (1-4 pixel diameter) concentrated in the central black medial zone and near the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent diagonal linear disruption (~40 pixels in length) cutting through the black pigment of the left lobe medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of 5-7 parallel, concentric curvilinear marks (rake marks) on the lower proximal region of the left lobe; significant irregular jagged truncation at the distal apex of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique fingerprint-style concentric arc pattern formed by high-contrast white pigmentation on the proximal ventral surface of the left lobe.
